TI 74LVC1G07DBVR open-drain buffer: GPIO2_EC low (battery) -> MXM PWR_LEVEL low (reduced power). Leave U2 unfitted for always-full power. Needs descriptor gpio2 = GPIO_FUNC_ACDC / OUTPUT_LOW / POWER_S3
GPIO2_EC pull-down: if the EC leaves the pin as an input (descriptor not changed), the card runs at reduced power rather than floating

Module EEPROM, 32 Kbit: EC reads 0x50 with 16-bit offsets. A0-A2=GND -> 0x50. WP=GND so the EC can program it. Contents: ExpansionBayConfigurationGenerator PCIE_THERMAL_3RDPARTY with PCIE_MUX_SEL low (keep DP_A AUX) and gpio2 = GPIO_FUNC_ACDC (drives PWR_LEVEL via U2)

Littelfuse SMBJ20A: 20 V standoff (= max VSYS), 22.2-24.5 V breakdown, 32.4 V clamp @ 18.6 A, 600 W
TI TPS25982 eFuse (2.7-24 V, 15 A; abs max IN 30 V). RGE0024M, pad 25 = IN, pad 26 = GND (TI 4223975/B land pattern). TPS25983 is pin-compatible (26 V, 20 A)
UVLO divider: V = 1.2 V x (R15+R16)/R16 = 6.5 V (MXM PWR_SRC min); EN = 3.7 V at 20 V (abs max 7 V)
UVLO divider bottom (see R15)

TI SN74LV1T08DBVR single-supply AND / level shifter at VCC 3.3 V: VIH max 1.37 V, so the 1.8 V host PWR_EN reads high; inputs tolerate up to 7 V abs max with VCC off. Y = PWR_EN AND eFuse PG -> MXM PWR_EN (3.3 V push-pull)
